_note.en: Annual irradiation loss (percent of the annual global irradiation on the tilted plane) if one portion of the sun-path chart of a province is blocked by an obstacle. 24 jurisdictions x 30 tables (tilt 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 deg; azimuth -60, -30, 0, 30, 60 deg, east positive). Each table has 14 hour bands (key = band number 1..14, as in the course chart) and, for each band, four values A, B, C, D (the four sun-path strips of the chart). The 120 values of a table add up to about 100 %. Extracted as numbers from the Annex C of a national solar-resource thesis (Wallace, UTN, Perez model, albedo 0.2). The obstacle profile is compared with the sun-path chart of the province (not included here); sum the values of the portions an obstacle covers. Not verified.
_note.es: Perdida anual de irradiacion (porcentaje de la irradiacion global anual en el plano inclinado) si un obstaculo tapa una porcion del diagrama de trayectorias del sol de una provincia. 24 jurisdicciones x 30 tablas (inclinacion 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90 grados; azimut -60, -30, 0, 30, 60 grados, este positivo). Cada tabla tiene 14 bandas horarias (clave = numero de banda 1..14, como en el abaco del curso) y, por banda, cuatro valores A, B, C, D (las cuatro franjas de la trayectoria solar del abaco). Los 120 valores de una tabla suman cerca de 100 %. Extraido como numeros del Anexo C de una tesis nacional del recurso solar (Wallace, UTN, modelo de Perez, albedo 0,2). El perfil de obstaculos se compara con el abaco de asoleamiento de la provincia (no incluido aqui); se suman los valores de las porciones que cubre el obstaculo. No verificado.

procedure: Obstacle points: azimuth and elevation measured from the centre of the array (azimuth positive to the east, 0 = north).
Overlay the obstacle profile on the sun-path chart of the province and list the covered portions (letter + number).
Pick the table closest to the tilt and azimuth of the surface.
Sum the loss of every covered portion.
